mode: Independent read-only static review of four newly added W5 tests
observations: The expected reasons for all eleven scope dimensions match the real helpers; reauthorize remains true on invalidation and reuse.
Substitutive import is represented by a coherent historical reference with changed incarnation; unrelated dependency changes are filtered from the envelope.
The deterministic recall fixture calls the actual mapper for each coherent case/event/bundle and recalculates owner, entry and projection digest; equal matches sort a-prior before z-prior.
Missing AtlasTrace reaches the authorized wrapper's fail-closed catch; forged module, operation and record digest are refused even with otherwise-successful authorization callbacks.
limits: The import test is a pure invalidation-boundary test, not execution of the real import producer.
The provenance negatives use controlled callbacks; they are not actual Atlas, native Session, SkillLoad or AM05 witnesses.
Static review does not replace hosted product execution or the package typecheck.
